tools.name: health
tools.title: Health and Data Freshness
tools.description: Database freshness: CVE/KEV/CWE counts and latest entries, and the sync state of each upstream feed. Costs no credits.

tools.name: cve_lookup
tools.title: CVE Lookup
tools.description: Full CVE record by ID (CVSS, EPSS, KEV, CWE, references, CISA SSVC, Nuclei templates), with the optional GitHub Security Advisory. Call the cve_products tool for every affected product. If your SSVC level is unknown, read high.

include_ghsa.description: Add the GitHub Security Advisory of the CVE, from the local copy of the GitHub Advisory Database

tools.name: cve_lookup_bulk
tools.title: Bulk CVE Lookup
tools.description: Look up many CVEs at once, each with the fields of cve_lookup. Ids beyond the remaining credits come back in not_processed.

tools.name: cve_products
tools.title: CVE Affected Products
tools.description: The products a CVE affects, one page at a time, with the vulnerable products first. The vendor and product arguments keep only the products with that exact name.

vendor.description: Exact vendor name, as affected_products writes it

product.description: Exact product name, as affected_products writes it

tools.name: cve_search
tools.title: CVE Search
tools.description: Search CVEs by severity, CWE, CVSS, EPSS, CISA KEV, ransomware use, Nuclei template, vendor, product and publish date, one page at a time. Call the cve_lookup tool for a full record, and the cpe_search tool to find the names.

min_cvss.description: CVSS v3, or v4 when a CVE has no v3

known_ransomware.description: Only CVEs whose CISA KEV entry notes known ransomware use

has_nuclei_template.description: Only CVEs with a Nuclei detection template

include_rejected.description: Also list the CVEs that NVD marks Rejected

tools.name: cve_leading
tools.title: Leading CVEs by EPSS
tools.description: List the CVEs most likely to be exploited, by EPSS score (the probability of exploitation in the next 30 days), with a verdict on the top score. To rank by composite risk score, call the cve_triage tool.

known_ransomware.description: Only CVEs whose CISA KEV entry notes known ransomware use

has_nuclei_template.description: Only CVEs with a Nuclei detection template

include_rejected.description: Also list the CVEs that NVD marks Rejected

tools.name: kev_lookup
tools.title: CISA KEV Lookup
tools.description: CISA KEV catalog entry for a CVE: the required action, the patch deadline and known ransomware use. A CVE that CISA removed answers in_kev false, and one never listed answers "KEV entry not found".

tools.name: cwe_lookup
tools.title: CWE Lookup
tools.description: CWE weakness details (description, mitigations, examples), with how many CVEs and CISA KEV entries name it. To list them, call the cve_search tool with its cwe_id argument.

tools.name: cve_risk_score
tools.title: CVE Risk Score
tools.description: Composite risk score of a CVE, from 0 to 100, for patch priority. It reads EPSS, CISA KEV, Metasploit, CVSS, NVD exploit references and ExploitDB. has_public_poc is null when no source names an exploit.

tools.name: cve_exploit
tools.title: CVE Exploit Intelligence
tools.description: Public exploit intelligence (GitHub PoCs, Metasploit, NVD exploit references, ExploitDB). GitHub PoC repositories are listed but not counted as proof of a public exploit.

tools.name: cve_triage
tools.title: CVE Triage
tools.description: Rank the CVEs of a vendor or product by composite risk score, at or above the optional min_risk_score argument, as lean rows (cve_id, risk_score, label). Call the cve_lookup tool for detail, and the cpe_search tool to find the names.

include_rejected.description: Also list the CVEs that NVD marks Rejected

tools.name: cve_triage_bulk
tools.title: Bulk CVE Triage
tools.description: Triage many CVEs at once, ranked by composite risk score. Ids beyond the remaining credits come back in not_processed.

tools.name: product_exposure
tools.title: Product Exposure
tools.description: CVE exposure of one vendor and product: severity, KEV and PoC counts, CVSS, EPSS, the worst risk score, the top CVEs and the endoflife.date support dates. To find the names, call the cpe_search tool.

version.description: Product version, e.g. 22.21.1 or 11-24h2; picks the release cycle of eol

include_rejected.description: Also count and list the CVEs that NVD marks Rejected

tools.name: cpe_search
tools.title: CPE Search
tools.description: Find the CPE vendor and product names that hold a text, ranked by vulnerable CVE count. Pass a name that holds no % as it is to the vendor and product arguments of the cve_search, cve_triage, cve_leading and product_exposure tools.

search.description: Text in vendor or product names, at least 3 bytes; case does not matter, and _ matches a space

tools.name: cvss_calculator
tools.title: CVSS Calculator
tools.description: Decode a CVSS v3.0/v3.1 vector into its base metrics and recompute its base, temporal and environmental scores.

tools.name: watchlist_edit
tools.title: Watchlist: CVE, Package, Domain and IP Monitoring
tools.description: Add, remove, list or clear the items this API key watches: CVEs, products, CVE searches, packages, domains and IP addresses. Read their changes with the watchlist_events tool. Requires a Pro API key.

action.description: add or remove; leave out to list the items

cve_id.description: For a cve_lookup, kev_lookup or cve_exploit item, e.g. CVE-2021-44228

vendor.description: Vendor, for a product_exposure or cve_search item

product.description: Product, for a product_exposure or cve_search item

min_cvss.description: CVSS v3, or v4 when a CVE has no v3; cve_search items only

min_epss.description: At most three decimals; cve_search items only

domain.description: For a dns_lookup, ssl_check, whois_lookup, headers_check or cert_search item, such as example.com

ecosystem.description: For a package_check item: npm, PyPI, Maven, Go, NuGet, RubyGems, crates.io, Packagist or SwiftURL

name.description: Package name of a package_check item, e.g. lodash

version.description: Exact version of a product_exposure or package_check item; leave out to watch every version

ip_address.description: Public IPv4 or IPv6 address of an ip_lookup item, such as 8.8.8.8, no prefix

clear.description: Deletes every item and the event cursor; takes no other argument

packages.description: package_check items, each with an ecosystem, a name and an optional version

tools.name: watchlist_events
tools.title: Monitoring Events
tools.description: Report what changed on the items this API key watches, such as a new advisory for a package or a certificate about to expire, oldest first. A plain call continues where the last one stopped. Requires a Pro API key.

limit.description: Events per call; repeat=true answers the whole last batch

cursor.description: next_cursor of an earlier answer; reads after it and keeps the position

repeat.description: Answers the last batch again; cannot be combined with cursor

tools.name: privacy_my_data
tools.title: Privacy: My Data
tools.description: What this server keeps about the caller: the hash its credits are counted under, the rate limit left in this hour and the privacy policy. For a Pro key, which vendor keys are stored and a 15-minute link to change them.

tools.name: vendor_key_edit
tools.title: Vendor key edit
tools.description: Save, delete or check your own Shodan and AbuseIPDB keys, which the ip_lookup tool uses. Needs a Pro API key or a manage link. The privacy_my_data tool gives a web link where a person can save the keys without the agent seeing them.

action.description: apply saves or deletes keys; status reports the stored keys and needs link

link.description: The 64 hex digits after #l= in a manage link; leave out to use this Pro API key

shodan_key.description: a Shodan key to check and save

abuseipdb_key.description: an AbuseIPDB key to check and save

tools.name: password_check
tools.title: Breached Password Check
tools.description: Check a password's SHA-1 against Have I Been Pwned's Pwned Passwords list. It takes the full SHA-1, never the password. Only its first 5 hex digits leave this server.

sha1_hash.description: SHA-1 of the password: 40 hex digits, either case

tools.name: dns_lookup
tools.title: DNS Lookup
tools.description: Look up a domain's DNS records: A, AAAA, MX, NS, TXT, CNAME, SOA and CAA. A record type the resolver could not answer is listed under unavailable.

tools.name: dns_takeover_check
tools.title: Subdomain Takeover Check
tools.description: Check a host name for subdomain takeover through a dangling CNAME. takeover_possible is null when the CNAME points to a service whose DNS does not show whether the name can be claimed.

tools.name: email_auth_check
tools.title: Email Authentication Check (SPF, DMARC, DKIM)
tools.description: Check a domain's mail authentication: SPF, DMARC (from a parent domain when the domain has no record of its own), DKIM, MX and MTA-STS, each check with pass, warn or fail and a severity.

dkim_selector.description: DKIM selector, such as google; without it the check tries the selectors of the domain's mail providers

tools.name: email_address_check
tools.title: Email Address Check
tools.description: Check an e-mail address without sending mail: whether its domain exists and takes mail, and whether a disposable domain list names it. It cannot tell whether the mailbox exists.

tools.name: ssl_check
tools.title: SSL/TLS Certificate Check
tools.description: Check the TLS certificate and settings of a host name on port 443: version, cipher, trust, OCSP revocation, expiry, DNS names, the chain and an abuse.ch SSL Blacklist listing.

tools.name: headers_check
tools.title: Security Headers Check
tools.description: Rate nine security headers of a web site, such as CSP, HSTS and Set-Cookie, from one GET to https://<domain>/ that follows up to 5 redirects on the same host or its www pair. Each finding that does not pass has a remediation.

domain.description: Host name of the site, such as www.example.com

include_full_header_values.description: true sends each header value and URL whole, instead of cutting it after 500 code points

tools.name: whois_lookup
tools.title: WHOIS / RDAP Lookup
tools.description: Look up a domain's registration over RDAP, or WHOIS where allowed: registrar, dates, status, name servers and DNSSEC. A name under a registered domain asks about that domain. No registrant data.

domain.description: Domain name, such as example.com; www.example.com asks about example.com

tools.name: wayback_lookup
tools.title: Wayback Machine Lookup
tools.description: List when the Wayback Machine captured a host's home page: the first and last capture, the years between them and the latest 10 captures with links.

tools.name: cert_search
tools.title: Certificate Transparency Search
tools.description: List the unexpired certificates that Certificate Transparency logs hold for a host name, wildcards included, from SSLMate's Cert Spotter: the 10 newest, with issuer, validity and DNS names. Costs 2 credits.

domain.description: Host name, such as example.com or www.example.com

tools.name: subdomain_enum
tools.title: Subdomain Enumeration
tools.description: List up to 50 subdomains of a registrable domain from Certificate Transparency, DNS queries for 94 common names and the domain's MX, NS and SPF records. Costs 2 credits.

domain.description: Domain name, such as example.com; www.example.com asks about example.com

tools.name: ip_lookup
tools.title: IP Lookup
tools.description: Look up a public IP address: AS, country, cloud provider, CDN, datacenter or Tor exit, DROP listing and PTR name. A Pro key with its own Shodan or AbuseIPDB key adds exposure and reputation.

ip_address.description: Public IPv4 or IPv6 address, such as 8.8.8.8 or 2001:4860:4860::8888

tools.name: asn_lookup
tools.title: ASN Lookup
tools.description: Look up an autonomous system by number, such as AS15169, or by an IP address it holds: name, country and one page of its IPv4 and IPv6 prefixes, derived from IPtoASN.

target.description: AS number, such as AS15169 or 15169, or a public IPv4 or IPv6 address, such as 8.8.8.8

tools.name: d3fend_for_attack
tools.title: D3FEND Defenses for ATT&CK
tools.description: MITRE D3FEND defenses that counter a MITRE ATT&CK technique. A technique id such as T1055 also matches its sub-techniques. Source: MITRE D3FEND (MIT license).

attack_technique_id.description: MITRE ATT&CK technique id in upper case, e.g. T1055 or T1055.012

tools.name: driver_lookup
tools.title: Windows Driver Lookup (LOLDrivers)
tools.description: Look up a Windows driver file hash in the LOLDrivers catalog of vulnerable and malicious drivers. Block on the file and Authenticode hashes, not on the detection rules. Source: LOLDrivers (Apache-2.0).

file_hash.description: MD5, SHA1 or SHA256 of the driver file, or its Authentihash: 32, 40 or 64 hex digits, either case

include_commands.description: true adds the catalog's command text to each match

tools.name: driver_lookup_bulk
tools.title: Bulk Windows Driver Lookup
tools.description: Look up many driver file hashes in the LOLDrivers catalog at once, each with the fields of driver_lookup. Hashes beyond the remaining credits come back in not_processed.

hashes.description: MD5, SHA1 or SHA256 of driver files or of their Authentihash

tools.name: package_check
tools.title: Package Vulnerability Check
tools.description: Check a package against the OSV.dev advisories (GitHub, Go, PyPA, RustSec) and the OpenSSF malicious package list, with the fixed version and endoflife.date dates. For severity, pass the CVE aliases to the cve_triage_bulk tool.

ecosystem.description: npm, PyPI, Maven, Go, NuGet, RubyGems, crates.io, Packagist or SwiftURL. Case does not matter.

name.description: Package name as the dependency file writes it, e.g. lodash, @babel/core, org.apache.logging.log4j:log4j-core, golang.org/x/net

version.description: Exact version, e.g. 4.17.20; without it every result is listed

tools.name: package_check_bulk
tools.title: Bulk Package Check (SBOM)
tools.description: Check many packages at once, each an ecosystem, a name and an exact version, against the advisories package_check reads. For the summary and ranges of an advisory, call the package_check tool.

items.description: Packages, each with its ecosystem, name and exact version
